description: Music held as an audio file, whether lossy, lossless compressed or uncompressed. Compression and resolution describe the file.
A book read aloud, kept as a file or set of files, either open or locked to an account, and either abridged or unabridged.
A typeface family kept as font files under a licence. The licence scope (desktop, web, app, server) varies for the same family.
A collectible card kept in a game platform account. A foil card is a shinier version of the same card.

A domain name registered under an ending, or a second-level name, that only certain kinds of registrant may use.
A non-fungible token that is the only one with its token number.
A token issued in several identical copies under one token number.
